content: Simulated initial designs #1 and #2. Design #1 (ln1=lp1=lp3=90nm) achieved gain 730 V/V, current 177 uA, PM 46.7 deg, SR 25.4 V/us, UGBW 28.8 MHz (reward -0.731). Design #2 with 45nm lengths suffered severe gds loading (gain 11.2). Conclusion: retain channel lengths at 90nm for DC gain. Key bottlenecks in #1: UGBW (28.8 MHz vs 100 MHz target), PM (46.7 deg vs 60 deg), SR (25.4 vs 30). In candidate #1, stage 2 transconductance gm6 and stage 1 gm1 need boost while optimizing Cc/Rc to reach stability and speed. Handing over to diagnoser with #1 as base.

Candidate #1 is best (reward -0.7314, infeasible). Violations: ugbw (-0.552, 28.8 MHz), phm (-0.124, 46.7 deg), slewRate (-0.084, 25.4 V/us). Gain (+0.570, 730 V/V) and current (177 uA) have ample margin. Primary lever: boost stage-1 gm1 by widening input pair (wn1 -> 2.5u, mn1 -> 16) and decrease cap from 1.5pF to 1.0pF. This will increase UGBW (~1.6x from gm1, 1.5x from Cc) and resolve slew rate. Base: candidate #1.

Candidate #3: mn1 10->16, wn1 1.5u->2.5u, cap 1.5p->1.0p. Reward improved from -0.7314 to -0.6528. Slew rate passed (33.9 V/us), ugbw improved to 37.5 MHz, noise improved to 0.0148. PM dropped to 37.4 deg because p2/zero shifted relative to UGBW. Need to address PM and further increase UGBW.

Simulated candidates #4 and sweep #5-#10 (Rc sweep 1.8k-4k on #4). Increasing Rc pushed zero into LHP, resolving PM: ID #10 (Rc=4000) achieves PM=73.6 deg, UGBW=58.97 MHz, SR=34.8 V/us, reward -0.2370. Only 1 violation remains: ugbw (59 MHz vs 100 MHz target). Returning to diagnoser.

Candidate #10 is best (reward -0.2370). Only 1 violation remains: ugbw (59.0 MHz vs 100 MHz target). PM has excess margin (73.6 deg vs 60 deg). Lever: reduce Cc (1.0pF -> 0.6pF-0.7pF) and increase mn1 (16 -> 20). Trading PM margin to increase UGBW ~1.7x will cross the 100 MHz feasibility boundary. Base: candidate #10.

Candidate #11: mn1=20, cap=0.6pF. Reward improved to -0.1878. PM=57.2 deg (-0.0237), UGBW=68.24 MHz (-0.189). All other specs passing (gain=749, SR=47, noise=0.014). Tail current needs to increase to pull gm1 out of weak inversion saturation, and Cc can be lowered to 0.4pF with higher Rc for phase lead. Base: candidate #11.

Candidate #13: mn1 20->24, wp1/wp3 1.5u->2.5u. Lesson: widening wp3 and wp1 increased Cgs of mp3, loading the stage 1 output node and degrading PM from 52.1 to 47.7 deg, despite UGBW rising to 92.1 MHz. Reverting to Candidate #12 (reward -0.112, UGBW 88 MHz, PM 52.1 deg) as base. Returning to diagnoser.

Candidate #12 is best (reward -0.1120). Violations: PM (52.1 deg vs 60 deg) and UGBW (88 MHz vs 100 MHz). All other specs well within limits. Lever: sweep Rc in [6.5k, 9.5k] on candidate #12. Moving the LHP zero lower provides phase lead (boosting PM) and high-frequency gain (boosting UGBW) without adding capacitive loading to stage 1. Base: candidate #12.

Rc sweep #14-#19 on #12: best is #17 (Rc=8000 ohm, reward -0.04623). UGBW resolved to 101.5 MHz (passing!). Only one violation remains across all constraints: PM at 52.7 deg (target 60.0 deg). Handing over to diagnoser to clear this final 7.3 deg margin to achieve full feasibility.

Candidate #17 is best (reward -0.04623), only PM (52.7 deg vs 60 deg) violates. Lever: boost gm6 by increasing mn5 (15 -> 20, I2=200uA) and reduce mp1 (4 -> 3) to maintain balance (mp3/mp1 = 24/3 = 8 = 2*20/5 = 8) and cut stage-1 load capacitance. This shifts p2 outward to cross 60 deg PM. Base: candidate #17.

Candidate #22 (cap=0.6pF on #21) achieved reward -0.01302. UGBW is 114.4 MHz, SR is 48.1 V/us, gain is 729 V/V, area is 8.16e-10, noise is 0.0142. Only PM violates at 56.99 deg (3.0 deg to 60 deg target). Increasing cap to 0.7pF-0.8pF or fine-tuning Rc will complete feasibility. Returning to diagnoser.

Candidate #22 is best (reward -0.01302). Only PM violates (56.99 deg vs 60.0 deg). UGBW is 114.4 MHz (+14.4 MHz margin). Lever: trade excess UGBW margin for PM by increasing cap 0.6p -> 0.7p and tuning res to 7000 ohm. Base: candidate #22.

Candidate #23 is FEASIBLE! Reward = 0.5548. Specs: gain=729 V/V, noise=0.0141, phm=60.91 deg, slewRate=44.13 V/us, ugbw=109.9 MHz, area=8.13e-10, current=280 uA. All hard constraints met. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 optimization.

Candidate #23 is feasible (FoM 0.5548). Current is 280 uA (z_current = +0.167 penalty). PM is tight at 60.91 deg. Lever: increase Rc to 7500 ohm to check if PM margin opens up, allowing current reduction. Base: candidate #23.

Candidate #26: mn1 22->20 on #25. Best feasible design: FoM=0.5597, PM=63.05 deg, UGBW=110.3 MHz, area=8.05e-10, current=280 uA. All hard constraints met with comfortable margins. Handing over to diagnoser.

Candidate #26 is best feasible (FoM 0.5597). PM=63.05 deg, UGBW=110.3 MHz. Lever: continue area optimization by reducing mn1 from 20 to 18. This trades excess UGBW margin for smaller layout area and higher FoM. Base: candidate #26.

Candidate #29 is best: FoM=0.5675, feasible, PM=66.56 deg, UGBW=110.3 MHz, area=7.927e-10, current=278.9 uA. Four consecutive iterations improved FoM by <0.005. Phase 2 optimization concludes; handing over to RL refinement. Base: candidate #29.

Phase 3 RL refinement complete: 500 simulations used (100 warmup + 400 train). Replay size 530, 11 feasible designs found across parameter space. Stopped after 2 batches without improvement. Best design remains #29 (FoM=0.5675, feasible). Parameters unchanged from expert best: mp1=3, wp1=1.5u, lp1=90n, mn1=14, wn1=2.5u, ln1=90n, mp3=24, wp3=1.5u, lp3=90n, mn3=3, wn3=1.0u, ln3=90n, mn4=5, wn4=1.0u, ln4=90n, mn5=20, wn5=1.0u, ln5=90n, cap=0.7pF, res=7000. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 4 polish.

Candidate #29 is best feasible (FoM 0.5675). PM is 66.56 deg (+6.56 deg margin). Lever: sweep Rc in [5000, 5500, 6000, 6500, 7000, 7500] on candidate #29 to reduce resistor area and test the optimum trade-off between area and phase margin. Base: candidate #29.

Rc sweep #530-#534 on candidate #29: best is #533 (Rc=6500 ohm). FoM jumped from 0.5675 to 0.5860. PM improved to 68.22 deg, UGBW is 104.2 MHz, area reduced to 7.57e-10 m^2. Fully feasible. Candidate #533 is the new best design.

Phase 3 Round 2 complete: 914 simulator calls reached (>= 900 stopping threshold). 99 feasible designs found across the trade-off space. Best design is #568 (FoM=0.6220, feasible). Parameters differ from expert best in cap: 0.5pF (vs 0.7pF), yielding area=6.904e-10 m^2 with PM=61.86 deg and UGBW=104.9 MHz. Handing over to Phase 4 polish.

Candidate #568 is best feasible (FoM 0.6220). Cap is 0.5pF. Lever: sweep Rc in [5500, 6000, 6500, 7000, 7500] on candidate #568 for final polish to optimize the resistor area vs stability trade-off. Base: candidate #568.

Rc sweep #915-#918 on candidate #568: Rc=6500 ohm confirmed as optimal design (FoM 0.6220, feasible, zero violations). Rc=6000 falls just short of UGBW (99.67 MHz), while Rc>=7000 increases resistor area. Candidate #568 is the verified final design. Handing over to Reviewer for Phase 5.

Review complete. Best design is candidate #568 (FoM=0.6220, feasible, 0 violations). Specs: Gain=722.2 V/V, UGBW=104.9 MHz, PM=61.86 deg, SR=51.81 V/us, Noise=0.0165 V RMS, Area=6.904e-10 m^2, Current=278.9 uA. Total simulations used: 918. Explanation written to harness_runs/harness_20261106_234417/explanation.md.
